body:
13.4.1 should  be structured to make query cost analysis one of the possible options rather than separating it.


> [13.4.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x21-V13-API.md#v134-graphql) - [GRAMMAR] Verify that a query allowlist or a combination of depth limiting and amount limiting is used to prevent GraphQL or data layer expression Denial of Service (DoS) as a result of expensive, nested queries. For more advanced scenarios, query cost analysis should be used.

comments.body: Perhaps:13.4.1 - [GRAMMAR] Verify that a query allowlist, depth limiting or query cost analysis is used to prevent Denial of Service (DoS) risks in GraphQL as a result of expensive, nested queries.
